payload.title: The red-first gate turns only GovernanceError into a named refusal, so an OSError or ValueError raised by the proof (a declared command with a NUL byte or an over-long argv, or a test path whose ancestor is a regular file at the base) escapes run_apply_gate and deliver_implementation and crashes the executor job with no named refusal
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:766-773 (pin files are written with mkdir and os.open, which raise FileExistsError or OSError)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:1376-1393 (parse_allowed_command admits any shlex-parsable text after python3 -m unittest, NUL and length included)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:998-1008 (_run_one catches only TimeoutExpired around the spawn)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/implementation_delivery.py:1041-1050 (run_apply_gate is wrapped for SandboxUnavailable and GovernanceError only)
payload.rule_violated: Every refusal of untrusted agent input is a named refusal (implementation_delivery stages and settlement); a fail-closed path must also fail by name (CLAUDE.md root-cause rule).
payload.notes: An agent declares red_first.command as a python3 -m unittest line with an embedded NUL (JSON can carry it) or a very long argument. parse_allowed_command admits it, the sandbox wrap builds a bwrap argv, and the spawn raises ValueError (embedded null byte) or OSError E2BIG (confirmed with a stdlib one-liner: shlex.split keeps the NUL, subprocess.run raises ValueError, a 300 KB argument raises OSError 7); none of _run_one, _red_first_decision or deliver_implementation catches it, so it reaches ci_executor with the request unsettled. The same escape occurs for an honest refactor that turns module calc.py into a package and adds calc/test_x.py: mkdir of calc/ under a regular file calc (validation.py:770) raises FileExistsError, also confirmed. Nothing is promoted (fail-closed); the cost is an unnamed job crash. Executor behaviour after the crash was not verified. Close condition: Make the prover's spawn and pin-write paths raise GovernanceError with a fixed code for OSError and ValueError, or have _red_first_decision map them to red_first_proof_refused; tests for a NUL command, an over-long command and a file-over-directory pin path assert the gate returns a blocked row named red_first_proof_refused. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
